name: 54001 · Amery, WI
findings: ZIP 54001 (Amery) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54001 (Amery) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54001 (Amery) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
